Renewal funnel by bucket — unique customers by time since last purchase

This breakdown counts unique customers, not deals. A customer sits in one bucket, set by how long before the month they last bought; the card leads with how many of them renewed. Deals cannot be split this way, which is why the card above carries the deal figures. Click a bucket to highlight it below.
